decisions.reason: Changing the selected date's display format does not alter the date field's Danish help text or general help-label behavior.
The date display format does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The checklist control is independent of the date selector's display format.
The source changes date formatting, not the separate dropdown control's type or document scope.
The date format decision does not alter the requirement to preserve Title field formatting.
The source specifies the displayed date format but does not change how fillable fields are made visible.
The robustness of ordinary text placeholders is unaffected by the date selector's output format.
Message 268 changes only the date format; the adjacent Enter discussion concerns a separate multiline-entry behavior.
The requested guidance about Master template tables remains valid without modification.
Theme color availability is unrelated to the date selector's day/month/year display format.
The date format change does not affect automatic bullet creation when Enter is pressed.
Changing date presentation does not alter the required alignment of Board Meeting fields.
